description: Header file defining the MockHelpers class for mocking in absl random internal, including mechanisms for invoking and registering mocks based on type signatures.

classes.name: MockHelpers
classes.description: Provides static methods for mocking support in absl random internal, including invoking and registering mocks based on type signatures.

methods.name: MaybeInvokeMock
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a mock for a given key signature and arguments, returning an optional result.

methods.name: MockFor
methods.description: Registers or retrieves a mock for a given key signature.
